name: fair-audience/fair-form-mailing-signup
title: Mailing Sign Up (legacy name)
description: Former name of fair-form/fair-form-mailing-signup, kept as a hidden alias so content saved under it keeps rendering and editing.

registration.detail: Registered on init whenever Fair Form is active, in PHP, as an alias of fair-form/fair-form-mailing-signup with its attributes, template and frontend assets. It has no editor script of its own; fair-form/fair-form-mailing-signup's editor script handles it in the editor.

minimal.title: Mailing opt-in in a form (legacy names)
minimal.description: The canonical minimal example saved under the legacy block names; renders the same as fair-form/fair-form-mailing-signup.

syntheticIds.formId: A UUID identifying this form within the post (submissions are grouped by it). Generate a fresh UUID (v4) per Fair Form block; the editor replaces a missing or duplicated one.
